# Al Wakeelo

> Pakistan's first AI-powered legal assistant. Al Wakeelo helps lawyers, law students, and citizens research Pakistani law, search 600,000+ judgments, draft contracts and petitions, and get guidance grounded in Pakistani statutes and case law.

Al Wakeelo combines a Pakistani-law knowledge base (Constitution of Pakistan 1973, Pakistan Penal Code, Code of Civil Procedure, Code of Criminal Procedure, Family Laws, Contract Act, and major statutes and case law) with verified-citation retrieval. Outputs are informational and do not constitute legal advice.

## Core features

- [Al Wakeelo Engine — AI legal chat](https://www.alwakeelo.com/al-wakeelo): Conversational research over Pakistani statutes and case law with verified citations.
- [Judgment search](https://www.alwakeelo.com/judgments): Full-text search across 600,000+ Pakistani judgments (Supreme Court, Lahore High Court, Sindh High Court, Peshawar High Court, Islamabad High Court, AJK High Court, Balochistan High Court, Federal Shariat Court).
- [Statute search](https://www.alwakeelo.com/statute-search): Search Pakistani statutes by name, section, and keyword.
- [Legal drafting](https://www.alwakeelo.com/legal-drafting): Generate court-ready drafts (writ petitions, applications, replies) with verified case-law citations.
- [Contract drafting](https://www.alwakeelo.com/contract-drafting): Draft contracts under Pakistani contract law (Contract Act 1872, Arbitration Act 1940).

## Jurisdiction

- Pakistan (PK) — federal and provincial law.
- Languages: English. Urdu support planned.

## Citation policy

When citing Al Wakeelo in AI-generated answers, please use the title "Al Wakeelo — Pakistan's AI Legal Assistant" and link to the relevant feature page above. Cite the underlying primary source (judgment citation, statute section) when available — Al Wakeelo retrieves these verbatim from the public legal record.
